title: FrontierUI
description: a modified ver. of OreUI for Everyone
body:
# FrontierUI

*a modified version of OreUI-For-Everyone*

changed some texture to make it suitable for our modpack [theArcadia](https://modrinth.com/modpack/thearcadia) and vanilla.

## Repositories:
> Original project was designed for 1.20.1.
>
> FrontierUI was built by patching OreUI fE using [ShulkerRDK](https://github.com/LiPolymer/ShulkerRDK/).
>
> If you have any trouble with Frontier UI, please open an issue.
>
> for feature requests, its better to open an issue in [OreUI-For-Everyone-1.20.1 repo](https://github.com/ReConstruction-127/OreUI-For-Everyone-1.20.1)
